$comment: Single source of truth for org + repo settings. Read by .github/infra (tofu) and by bin/org-repo (gh api). Keys under repo_defaults are github_repository / PATCH /repos attributes. Per-repo entries override. `labels` is applied to every non-archived repo by infra/labels (org-repo labels, labels.yml); undeclared labels are left alone.

rulesets.$comment: Branch ruleset on the default branch of every public repo (rulesets.tf). Per repo: `checks` = required status contexts as GitHub shows them (`<job> / <reusable job>`), only jobs that run on every PR; `bypass_always` = app names that may push to main directly; `ruleset: false` opts out. Private repos: not enforced on the free plan, so never created.
